summary: LATAM Airlines Group filed a Form 6-K on July 10, 2026 containing monthly operating statistics for June 2026. The filing details month, quarter, and year-to-date metrics including capacity (ASK), traffic (RPK), load factor, passengers boarded, and cargo volumes versus the prior year. No M&A, activist, restructuring, or other special-situations transaction is described. This is a routine operational update from a foreign private issuer under Rule 13a-16, not a special-situation event.
